name: nebula-token
description: The ten NEBULA agent skills, served from the specification repository they are checked against. Each entry exposes one language implementation's skill; the skill files are not copied here, they are read in place from packages/<language>/skills/.

plugins.name: nebula-token-typescript
plugins.description: Add login sessions with rotating refresh tokens to a TypeScript or Node.js backend, or replace hand-rolled and JWT refresh tokens, using nebula-token from npm. Covers reuse detection, revocation and the production store contract.
